insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified in provided extract (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ + Safeguard/Safeguard+ + ReAssure+/ReAssureX as per Policy Schedule/variant)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You can choose any room category without a daily rent limit, giving you full flexibility. This means no daily room rent cap will reduce your claim amount.

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: “...Pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.explanation: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases can be as low as 12 months in some variants. This allows earlier coverage for pre-existing conditions.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: “...listed conditions... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.reference: Section 5.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
great.explanation: Waiting period for specified illnesses can be as low as 12 months in some variants. This means you get coverage for listed illnesses sooner than usual.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: Once triggered, the restore benefit provides unlimited additional sum insured for life, subject to renewal without break. This gives you extra coverage beyond the base sum insured multiple times.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident...”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents which are covered from day one. This is the industry standard waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization
good.quote: “...for 60 days before the date of admission...”
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This helps cover diagnostic and treatment costs leading to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered. This supports recovery costs after hospital treatment.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. We will pay up to Base Sum Insured.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.1 Expenses in reaching a Hospital
good.explanation: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered up to the base sum insured. This ensures quick hospital transfer in emergencies.

good.name: Domiciliary Treatment
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home... we will pay... provided that: a. The medical practitioner advices... b. ...continuous active line of treatment... c. Daily monitoring chart...”
good.explanation: Home treatment is covered when medically advised and monitored as per conditions. This helps if hospitalization is not possible but treatment is needed at home.

good.name: Organ Donor Cover
good.quote: “...we will pay the hospitalization expenses of the donor for harvesting the organ, ONLY when your Hospitalization claim is paid.”
good.explanation: Hospitalization expenses of the organ donor are covered if the insured’s transplant claim is paid. This supports organ donation procedures.

good.name: Worldwide Cover
good.quote: “This Policy covers Allopathic treatments anywhere in the world.”
good.explanation: Allopathic treatments are covered globally, though claims are settled in INR. This allows treatment abroad under the policy.

good.name: AYUSH Coverage
good.quote: “AYUSH treatments are covered in India only.”
good.explanation: AYUSH treatments are covered but only within India. This provides alternative medicine coverage domestically.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments, up to Base Sum Insured for the list as specified below...”
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered up to the base sum insured and limited to a specified list. This ensures access to advanced therapies within limits.

good.name: Optional Covers
good.quote: “Optional Benefit: 4.1.14 Annual Aggregate Deductible... 4.1.16. Co-Payment... 4.1.17 Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Time Modification... 4.1.18 Room Type Modification... 4.1.23 Borderless... 4.1.25 WellConsult (OPD)”
good.explanation: Several optional benefits allow you to customize premium and coverage by choosing add-ons. These are flexible choices, not mandatory restrictions.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Annexure I - The expenses that are not covered... List I – Expenses not covered”
bad.explanation: Many consumables like gloves and masks are not covered by default, causing out-of-pocket expenses unless you opt for Safeguard/Safeguard+. This can increase your costs.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: No explicit NCB/cumulative bonus accrual rate and reset terms provided in the supplied extract (only definition of 'Cumulative Bonus' appears).
bad.explanation: No clear terms on No Claim Bonus are provided, so it is assumed not available. This means you may not get premium discounts for claim-free years.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement...” and separately “Optional Benefit: ... 4.1.16. Co-Payment...”
bad.explanation: Co-pay is described as an optional benefit but the default plan’s co-pay percentage is not clearly stated. Check your policy schedule to confirm if any co-pay applies.

unclear.name: Restore Conditions
unclear.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured... Maximum amount ReAssure+ pays for any single claim is up to Base Sum Insured.”
unclear.explanation: The restore benefit exists but it is unclear if it covers the same illness repeatedly within a policy year or how it applies across multiple claims. Full wording needed.

unclear.name: Proportionate Deduction
unclear.quote: “If you opt for a Hospital room which is higher than the eligible room category as specified in your Policy Schedule, then We will pay only a pro-rated portion...”
unclear.explanation: Proportionate deduction applies if you choose a room above your eligible category, but the eligible room category is not shown here. Confirm your schedule to know if this affects you.

unclear.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY. As list of network hospitals is dynamic, for the latest list, refer to our website...”
unclear.explanation: The size of the cashless hospital network is not specified, so it is unclear how extensive or convenient cashless access will be.
